summary: Four model-ready prompt drafts implement the approved visual modules with neutral packaging, explicit negative constraints, and post-generation review gates.

data.usage_notice: Draft prompts are executable for controlled concept generation. They are not approved final campaign prompts and must not include real brand assets until authorization is recorded.

prompts.prompt: Premium editorial skincare macro photograph, a single translucent watery serum droplet forming at the tip of a clear glass dropper above a warm ivory surface, physically plausible viscosity, soft directional morning daylight, subtle sage reflection, crisp micro-detail, restrained luxury, generous upper-left negative space for later typography, no label, no logo, no skin, no medical diagram, no text, photorealistic product photography
prompts.negative_prompt: brand logo, readable text, clinical cross-section, glowing particles, skin penetration, miracle effect, excessive sparkle, thick gel, impossible reflections, distorted glass, watermark

prompts.prompt: Clean editorial bathroom shelf in soft natural daylight, four clearly separated neutral skincare objects arranged left to right as cleanser, unlabeled serum dropper bottle, moisturizer jar, sunscreen tube, warm ivory stone and pale sage accents, simple three-step visual rhythm, realistic scale and shadows, right side negative space for numbered labels added later, inclusive contemporary home styling, no logos, no embedded words, photorealistic commercial still life
prompts.negative_prompt: brand packaging, readable labels, medical symbols, prescription products, clutter, luxury marble excess, impossible shadows, warped containers, floating objects, watermark
review: replace serum with approved packshot only after rights check
ensure props do not resemble competitors

prompts.prompt: Authentic creator-style vertical beauty scene, adult hand with natural unretouched skin holding a generic unlabeled serum bottle beside a bathroom mirror, soft morning window light, warm neutral and pale sage palette, subtle handheld framing, visible real skin texture, one controlled droplet on fingertip, lower-third safe space for captions, calm educational mood, realistic photography, no brand identity, no before-and-after comparison
prompts.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, child, flawless plastic skin, skin lightening, acne removal, split-screen transformation, testimonial text, logo, readable packaging, extra fingers, deformed hand, exaggerated pore removal, watermark
review: check hand anatomy and skin realism
record synthetic-person disclosure requirement by market

prompts.prompt: High-end e-commerce skincare still life, centered generic frosted glass serum bottle with blank label on a warm ivory matte surface, restrained translucent ingredient-inspired abstract shapes in the background, soft controlled studio daylight, accurate straight bottle geometry, clean charcoal-shadow contrast, ample empty space for verified feature callouts added later, photorealistic, conversion-focused composition without promotional claims
prompts.negative_prompt: real logo, readable text, certification badge, molecule diagram, medical imagery, competitor packaging, sale sticker, glowing aura, impossible bottle, duplicate caps, warped label, watermark
review: composite final authorized packshot instead of using generated package

risks: Generated packaging is not an accurate product representation
Human anatomy and skin realism require inspection
Platform-specific AI disclosure rules require current legal review
next_actions: Route selected frames to post-generation compliance review
